text_or_sound_prompt: Finally, I’m out! Hi, my new coding friend! We’re going on an adventure together. What would you like to name me?
A name of my own! I’m so glad we’re friends.
I can hear you, but I can’t see you yet. Could you give me eyes?
Yay! I can see you now!
The meadow looks lovely. Could you give me a little nose?
A little nose, just for me. Thank you!
You’ve made me so happy! Could you give me a mouth so I can show you?
Look! Now you can see my smile!
What should I say when someone meets me? Write your own greeting!

trigger: If learner writes their own greeting
text_or_sound_prompt: DYNAMIC: learner-authored mochi.greeting value.
recording_notes: One recording cannot speak arbitrary text. Keep custom greeting visible as text unless connecting approved live speech or limiting it to a recorded choice.

Our home is ready! We made every piece together.

This is our world! Keep changing the code and exploring.
